name: education-agent-skills
title_zh: 165 个教学技能，每个都标了证据出处
tagline_zh: 备课、评课、设计课程，不再凭感觉拍脑袋。每个技能都挂靠真实研究，Claude、Codex 都能跑。
tagline_en: Stop guessing in lesson planning & assessment. Every skill cites real learning-science research. Runs in Claude.
desc_en: 165 evidence-grounded AI skills for teachers, school leaders and EdTech builders—pedagogy, learning science, curriculum, assessment and regeneration. Claude, Codex and Hermes.
why_zh: 不是零散提示词堆砌，而是按教学法、学习科学、课程、评估四大域组织，每条技能都锚定证据。
why_en: Not scattered prompts—organized across pedagogy, learning science, curriculum & assessment, each anchored to cited evidence.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 K-12 与教师工作流，不含高等教育或企业培训；技能依赖 Anthropic/OpenAI 模型能力。
limit_en: K-12 & teacher workflows only—no higher-ed or corporate training. Requires strong LLM (Claude/Codex-class); weak local models will struggle. Gives.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: 165 teaching skills, each with evidence cited
